content.text: We have 4 hidden units. Input weights matrix 4x2: rows: unit0: [0,1]; unit1: [0,-1]; unit2: [1,0]; unit3: [-1,0]. biases all zero. ReLU. Output weights 2x4 all zeros. So outputs always zero. argmax class 0 wins ties. Desired class 1 iff x0>0. Currently always class0. Need to preserve x0 circuit. Which hidden units encode x0? unit2 uses x0 positive weight 1. unit3 uses -1. So x0 circuit present. But output weights zero, so no effect. To get class1 when x0>0, need output weight from unit2 positive to class1, and maybe negative to class0. But question: "If a nuisance circuit overrides it, name the TWO hidden units whose outgoing weights should become zero." Here nuisance circuit? x1 is nuisance. Units 0 and1 depend on x1. They could override. So set outgoing weights of units 0 and1 to zero. So answer: 0,1.
